# Run Modes Checklist: Dev and Prod Run Modes

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review for run modes — dev/prod commands, dev-server failure handling, README documentation, end-to-end verification
**Created**: 2026-09-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are both prod deliverables (installer and standalone app) and the standalone-only variant each stated as requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK002 Does the README requirement cover every troubleshooting situation the spec identifies (error page, port in use, transient compile error, an already-running copy)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK003 Is it specified whether the rest of the app (e.g. the local API) still starts while the dev-server message is shown? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK004 Is a pre-change baseline for test counts, performance and startup required, so SC-005 has something to compare against? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is "clean clone" defined (which local state must be absent) for the FR-009 verification? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK006 Is "no network access other than its own local API" stated in a way that can be verified in practice? [Measurability, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK007 Is it unambiguous who tells the contributor where the prod outputs are ("prints or documents")? [Ambiguity, Spec §US2 AC1]
- [x] CHK008 Is "development build" defined so it is clear that `cargo run --release` is also covered by FR-003? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Are the dev-server message requirements consistent between FR-003, US1 AC4, SC-003 and the Clarifications answer? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK010 Do FR-008 and the port-in-use edge case describe the same outcome (terminal message plus window message)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK011 Is the assumption that the compile error needs no code fix consistent with US1 AC3 and FR-007? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK012 Is the recovery path specified after the message is shown (does the window recover by itself once the dev server starts, or must the app be restarted)? [Gap, Recovery, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK013 Is the interaction between an installed prod copy and a dev launch (shared single instance) addressed? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK014 Are requirements stated that the dev-server check can never affect prod builds? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK015 Is the installer path of US2 bounded (install, run, and removal afterwards so it does not linger for later dev runs)? [Coverage, Spec §US2 AC3]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK016 Are SC-003 (message within 5 s) and SC-004 (change visible within 2 s) measurable without knowing the implementation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK017 Is it specified where the end-to-end verification results are recorded so they can be repeated? [Traceability, Spec §FR-009]

## Non-Functional & Constraints

- [x] CHK018 Is the dev-server check consistent with the localhost-only network constraint? [Consistency, Constitution Project Constraints]
- [x] CHK019 Is the README requirement explicit that the existing CI-check and Spec Kit guidance stay in place? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
